capabilities.justification: The loader/CLI read the curriculum's lesson Markdown, concept taxonomy, per-language sound-tag owners, per-lesson modality owners, gentle-ramp metric/finding owners, and script JSON from the repo working tree to build and validate the cross-language dataset.

The loader enumerates each track's lessons/ directory, core/sound-tags.d/, core/lesson-modality/*.d/, core/gentle-ramp-snapshots/*.d/, and data/scripts/ to discover and verify the exact files to parse.
The explicit generate:books command refreshes configured LaTeX chapters from the canonical lesson AST; CI normally uses the read-only check:books drift gate.

The explicit generate:books command refreshes stable metadata and chapter-owned app/book source-hash files inside registered language directories; CI normally verifies them without writing, and no flat aggregate is written.

The explicit generate:modality command refreshes only direct per-language metadata and per-lesson modality owners; it cannot write the removed flat aggregates. CI normally uses the read-only check:modality drift gate.
The explicit generate:gentle-snapshots command refreshes stable per-language metadata owners after validating a complete staged tree; no flat aggregate path is granted.
The explicit generate:gentle-snapshots command refreshes only fixed metric identities; CI normally uses the read-only check:gentle-snapshots drift gate.
The explicit generate:gentle-snapshots command refreshes only fixed finding-kind identities; CI normally uses the read-only check:gentle-snapshots drift gate.
The explicit generate:narration command refreshes the HL08 plain-text voice script for each chapter from the canonical lesson AST; CI normally uses the read-only check:narration drift gate.
The explicit generate:narration command refreshes the HL08 structured narration a voice agent consumes; CI normally uses the read-only check:narration drift gate.

The explicit generate:narration command refreshes stable metadata and chapter-owned source/output hash files inside registered language directories to detect drift between lessons and committed voice scripts; CI normally verifies them without writing, and no flat aggregate is written.
The explicit generate:progress command refreshes one independently mergeable progress card per registered language; CI normally uses the read-only check:progress drift gate.

justification: Filesystem access stays in loader-backed CLI entry points. Validation/reporting are read-only; the explicit generators write only configured LaTeX chapters, per-chapter narration scripts, chapter-owned generated-hash files, direct per-lesson modality owners, direct gentle-ramp metric/finding owners, and per-language progress cards. No network or process access is needed.
